span.p:
CLAIM PHASE — first-push-wins
1. git pull main · 2. cat ledger · 3. find first matching TODO row
4. row → CLAIMED · 5. commit + push

span.p:
IMPLEMENT PHASE — on a worktree
6. read brief · 7. git worktree add /tmp/<brief> · 8. checkout -b
9. implement (stay in may-touch) · 10. cargo build / clippy / test · verify LOC budget

span.p:
REVIEW PHASE — open PR & stop
11. push branch · 12. gh pr create (brief title + acceptance)
13. row → IN_REVIEW + PR num · 14. commit + push
